content: Email gateway flagged message to j.malheiro@company with link https://secure-portal.invoice-update.com/invoice — technique T1566.002 spearphishing link
Triage: user j.malheiro clicked the link on ws-fin-0042.corp.company.com. Credential phishing suspected, case escalated to threat response
Investigated secure-portal.invoice-update.com — newly registered domain impersonating our invoice portal. Hosting infrastructure recently provisioned
Passive DNS shows secure-portal.invoice-update.com resolved_to 203.0.113.77 during the campaign window
Restricted: second target confirmed — VP Finance received variant of the same phish. Executive protection notified, do not broadcast target list
Threat hunt: ws-fin-0042.corp.company.com beaconing to 203.0.113.77 over HTTPS every 60s matching T1071.001 web protocol C2 pattern
Payload retrieved from ws-fin-0042.corp.company.com: sha256 9f2b8c1d4e6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e loader consistent with phantom-portal campaign tooling
Hunt pivot: second C2 endpoint 198.51.100.23 observed in JA3 fingerprints; same loader hash 9f2b8c1d4e6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e seen contacting it
User reported a portuguese-language variant of the invoice phish targeting the São Paulo office
Campaign assessment: infrastructure overlap and tooling tie this activity to actor phantom-panda, financially motivated
Auto-triage: duplicate alert on ws-fin-0042.corp.company.com outbound connection correlated with known incident, closed as duplicate of the phantom portal case
Sweep complete: no additional hosts exhibit beaconing to 203.0.113.77 or 198.51.100.23 — containment confirmed
